verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's Session Replay docs say you can follow up on drop-offs by exploring why customers drop off. Replays can also be grouped into playlists based on events or properties, so product-owned replay tied to funnel drop-off and event filters is documented. However, the evidence is thin on the actual one-click jump from a funnel step to the affected users' replays, and error events are never mentioned. Missing for 10: documented drill-down UI from a funnel drop-off step to the replays of those specific users, explicit support for jumping from error events to replays, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can jump from a funnel drop-off or an error event straight to session replays of the affected users

citations.quote: Now, with Mixpanel Session Replay, you can quickly follow up by exploring why customers drop off.
Save playlists of replays based on events or properties, and quickly review with AI summaries
